choices.text: <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">|</mo><mover><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">|</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">|</mo><mover><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>A</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">|</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>
Véc-tơ <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mover><mn>0</mn><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover></semantics></math> cùng phương với mọi véc-tơ
Véc-tơ <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mover><mn>0</mn><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover></semantics></math> cùng hướng với mọi véc-tơ

solution: Từ các phương án đã cho, ta thấy mệnh đề sai là <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mover><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>A</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></semantics></math> (vì <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mover><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>A</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mn>0</mn><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover></mrow></semantics></math>).
